decisions.reason: As a multi-model product line building on the established offer with its own page, the firm's visible investment and commitment make it reluctant to write off the effort.
The chair family is close to the established offer and had a dedicated page, so the moderate investment and public presence support persistence.
As a multi-model line grounded in existing carpet materials, it represents significant sunk investment, leading management to keep it rather than admit failure.
The dedicated page and public designer launch quote signal visible commitment, making withdrawal harder to justify despite its smaller scale.
With little invested in a single close-to-core table and no special public commitment beyond a standard page, management can drop it without large write-offs or public justifications.
As the flagship rug collection presented as central to the firm's announced direction, its strong public commitment and high investment make dropping it very unlikely.
